_comment_openInvoiceModel: DEBENQ_CURRENT.TXT has no reliable INVNO tagging on payment rows. Open list = LPG gas invoices only (EMPTY/CYL deposit pairs stripped); gas Crd Notes net against their DN-base invoice. See analysis/debtors/MD0003/reports/MD0003_Open_Invoices.md.
_comment_openInvoicesFromDate: 2026-09-21 operator decision: scope this statement to FY2026 only. Pre-2026 rows (including 4 unratified 2025 billing months — Mar/Apr/May/Aug — and the R12,263.61 standing-credit origin traced to payment 42440/STAT:121) are excluded entirely, not asserted paid. That pre-2026 gap is tracked separately in MD0003_Open_Invoices.md and project.json and is not shown on this document until resolved.
_comment_customerDueBasis: Amount due = open FY2026 LPG invoices only (R30,599.47). No opening balance / account-level bridge shown on the customer document while the pre-2026 gap is under investigation.

allocationGate.note: STAT batch closes are remittance/customer-AP-ledger matched (see payment_pattern_overrides.json) but DEBENQ_CURRENT.TXT itself carries no INVNO tagging on payments, so the generator's invariant check (Σ open ≤ ERP CURRENT BALANCE) does not apply cleanly to a 2026-scoped list against a full-account ERP header — it is expected to show BLOCKED/overstated and must be run with --force. This is the same pre-2026 standing-credit gap tracked in MD0003_Open_Invoices.md, not a new discrepancy.
